jobs.summary: Contributing to the development and maintenance of a pharmaceutical data management system in the Cobenfy project for Bristol Myers Squibb.
tasks: Contribute to the development and maintenance of the project's pharmaceutical data management system.

Implement and customize charts and tables with Highcharts and VXETable to display general sales data (TRx, NBRx) and execution data (Call, Sample, Program, Email, IVA…) across Geo, MHC, and HCP modules.
Fix chart and report issues involving display, sorting, filtering, column handling, and Excel/PowerPoint export to ensure correct operation.
outcomes: Gained an understanding of pharmaceutical data structures: Prescription, Account, Geography, Sales, and Execution.
Improved problem-solving and debugging skills through practical system issues.
Gained hands-on experience with Vue.js 2 and ASP.NET Core APIs.
Worked in an Agile/Scrum environment, managed tasks with Jira, and collaborated with project managers and mentors.

jobs.summary: Joined the First Cloud Journey Program, learned the fundamentals of AWS services, and applied that knowledge in an internship project.
tasks: Acquired foundational knowledge of various AWS services.
Built an internship project and applied the knowledge learned in practice.
outcomes: Learned how to combine S3, Lambda, API Gateway, and DynamoDB in a basic serverless application.
Practiced CRUD operations: creating, reading, updating, and deleting product data.

projects.title: EasyTalk
projects.subtitle: AI-powered English learning platform
projects.summary: Bringing learning journeys, exercises, revision, and AI assistance into a structured English learning experience.
features: Journey, Gate, and Stage learning paths with grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, dictation, and reading activities.
Flashcards, reminders, streaks, badges, and leaderboards.
AI flows for conversation, writing feedback, and study guidance; a chatbot with AWS Bedrock Knowledge Bases retrieval.
An admin portal for learning content, users, and analytics dashboards.
architecture: Separate learner web, admin portal, business API, and AI service.
React/Vite frontends; Node.js/Express backend with MongoDB, Redis, and Socket.IO.
Docker Compose configuration and GitHub Actions workflows for AWS deployment.

projects.title: SportElite
projects.subtitle: Sports e-commerce website
projects.summary: A shopping experience covering product discovery, color and size selection, ordering, order tracking, and product reviews.
features: Product search, suggestions, filters, pagination, featured products, and related products.
Color, size, and quantity selection with a cart persisted in localStorage.
Shipping information, delivery fee calculation, order creation, status history, and conditional cancellation.
JWT registration and login, user profiles, wishlists, and product reviews.
architecture: Vue 3 frontend with Pinia and Vue Router, communicating with the backend through Axios.
ASP.NET Core 8 backend organized into Controller, Service, and Repository layers, with Entity Framework Core and SQL Server.
JWT and BCrypt for authentication, and Cloudinary for image management.
